blockers.repair: Fix or redesign the synchronous semantic timeout path and rerun free Mode 2 successfully.

evidence.fact: The E03 eval_corpus_quality_backfill record is not_run because the semantic lane was not stable enough to justify paid characterization.

blockers.repair: After Mode 2 passes, complete the quality-suite backfill and prove zero semantic_unavailable notices on warm probes.

conclusion: E09 is not evaluated and supports no ship, bound, or cut verdict for the semantic lane. Keep semantic_lane default-off. Repair and pass E03 Mode 2, then complete the quality backfill before reconsidering E09.
